description: This source file defines a utility class 'AuthUtil' that provides methods for extracting a user/owner ID from HTTP request headers. It is intended as a helper for optional scoping, not secure authentication.

classes.name: AuthUtil
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to extract user identifiers from request headers.

methods.name: extractOwnerId
methods.description: Extracts the owner/user ID from the 'X-User-Id' request header. Returns null if header is missing or blank.

methods.name: userHeaderName
methods.description: Returns the name of the header used for user scoping, 'X-User-Id'.
